name: Odoo Global Discount on Sale,Purchase & Invoice with Tax calculation
description:
Odoo doesn't support discounts with tax calculations, but this module enables discounts in Sales
     Orders, Purchase Orders, Customer Invoices, and Vendor Bills. It offers Fixed and Percentage discounts, applicable
      on individual line items or the total amount—before or after tax. Users can configure discounts globally or per
      order line, set up discount accounts separately for Sales and Purchases, and generate journal entries when 
      invoices are validated.

description:

Perfect for performance tracking, SLA monitoring, bottleneck detection, and agile project reporting.

name: Payment Method Restriction
description:
Take full control of your payment options with the Payment Method Restriction app. This powerful Odoo extension lets you configure and manage the availability of payment methods based on specific business rules.Whether you want to restrict payment methods for certain customer groups, products, shipping methods, or order values — this app gives you the flexibility to create dynamic and tailored payment rules.
Key Features:

Restrict payment methods by customer group or user type

Enable/disable payment options for specific products or categories

Set order value conditions (e.g., minimum/maximum) for payments

Control payment methods based on shipping or delivery method

Define custom rules to match your business logic

Seamless integration with Odoo eCommerce and Sales

Easy-to-use configuration interface

name: Employee Timesheet Entry Limit
description: Employee Timesheet Entry Limit helps organizations maintain accurate and compliant timesheet records by enforcing strict control over employee time entries.  With this app, you can configure the maximum number of working hours allowed per day or week. Employees will not be able to log timesheet entries that exceed these limits, ensuring that all records stay within company policy. Additionally, the app prevents timesheet entries on designated weekly off days, such as weekends or custom holidays.  This ensures time tracking is consistent, fair, and aligned with organizational rules reducing errors, misuse, and manual validations.
